notes:
Not finished yet. If a generation view is shown it tracks progress and polls by itself, so there is nothing to do here. Only call creative_get_flow_run_status yourself if no view appeared: wait poll_after_seconds, then call it with this flow_id and session_ids, repeating until all_completed or has_failures is true.
The result renders as a speech view: it plays the takes, and offers the user a voice switcher and a pager over every take generated so far. Switching voice there starts and charges another generation of this same line, appended as a take, and is published to you as widget context — read that rather than asking what they switched to.
